animation_description: Steady relaxed walk cycle in place, one full loop of two steps, arms swinging naturally opposite to legs, subtle body bob. This is a HEADLESS body: it ends at a short neck stump, never draw a head, face, hair or skull. Keep the same outfit, proportions and pixel scale in every frame; talisman, gourd and sash tails sway lightly. No travel across the canvas, no ground shadow, no weapon.
